mapper.select: select ro.id, ro.registration_player_id, ro.player_id, ifnull(nullif(p.game_nickname, ''), mp.nickname) as player_name, p.player_no, ro.jersey_no, ro.roster_role, ro.is_starting, ro.captain_flag, ro.position_code, ro.play_status, ro.sort_no from basket_match_roster ro left join basket_player_profile p on ro.player_id = p.id and p.is_delete = 0 left join basket_member_profile mp on mp.member_id = p.member_id and mp.is_delete = 0 where ro.match_id = #{matchId} and ro.team_id = #{teamId} and ro.is_delete = 0 order by ro.sort_no, ro.id
select count(1) from basket_match_roster where match_id = #{matchId} and team_id = #{teamId} and is_starting = 1 and is_delete = 0
select count(1) from basket_match_roster where match_id = #{matchId} and team_id = #{teamId} and captain_flag = 1 and is_delete = 0
mapper.update: update basket_match_roster set is_delete = 1, update_time = now() where match_id = #{matchId} and team_id = #{teamId} and is_delete = 0
